turns.question: What was the median site session duration in minutes between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for site session duration, so I can't give a median in minutes for 20 September to 3 October 2026. The closest metrics are Site sessions (sessions with a page view, counted by day) and Engaged customers (7 days), which count sessions and activity rather than length.
